title: San Francisco’s single-room housing reports ran as much as 111 days late

beats.text: Some San Francisco single-room housing reports counted residents incorrectly.

visual.sub: Five of eight project reports had errors, late submission or missing approval

beats.text: Five of eight reports tested in 2016 had errors, late filing or missing approval.
Two properties had errors in their count on the last day of the year.
Then the Hotel Isabel performance report arrived 82 days late.

visual.kicker: Hotel Isabel and Hamlin Hotel reports were 82 and 99 days late

beats.text: Hamlin Hotel’s report was 99 days late.
Six other annual forms in that audit were each 50 days late.

visual.kicker: Hotel Isabel and Hamlin Hotel reports were 82 and 99 days late

beats.text: In the following audit, two annual forms arrived 111 days late.

visual.kicker: Two filings in the next audit were 111 days late

beats.text: Six funding estimates tested were each 40 days late.

visual.kicker: Two filings in the next audit were 111 days late

beats.text: All seven funding estimates for fiscal 2019 arrived 41 days late.
The next audit reported that the corrective action had been implemented.

visual.kicker: All seven funding estimates were late before a later audit recorded corrective action

beats.text: The records give no penalty or lost benefit amount.
Every source is linked in the case file below.
